description: An independent community exploring a longer useful life for legacy graphics hardware on Windows. Discover GRELECY and help shape the project.
hero_intro: An independent community exploring a longer useful life for legacy graphics hardware on Windows.
logo_alt: GRELECY emblem: a silver G on a green graphics card
stage_detail: No drivers or software releases are available yet.
project_intro: Working hardware can still have value after official support ends. GRELECY brings owners, testers and developers together to document problems and explore what is possible.
project_method: We start with evidence, share what we learn, and choose achievable goals together.
research_intro: We gather hardware reports, investigate compatibility and assess technical proposals. The community helps define the first achievable objective.
scope_note: A product series is not an architecture. Exact GPU models matter. No support is guaranteed.
contribute_intro: You do not need to write code to contribute.
join_detail: Share your hardware, interests and skills.
report_detail: Record your GPU, Windows build and reproduction steps.
propose_detail: Bring a focused question and a way to test it.
independence: Independent community project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by NVIDIA.
license_notice: Documentation CC BY 4.0 · Software MPL 2.0 · Brand assets reserved.
